'''Tyvar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], codenamed '''Lurker'''. Retired by the time of the [[Galactic War]], he settled on [[Makeb]] and lives there with his family: his wife [[Chiana]], son [[Peron]] and daughter [[Syla]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] the Empire asked Lurker to reactivate and provide them with the information that would help in recovery of the [[Isotope-5]]. Unfortunately, the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] became aware of his true allegiance as well and set the [[InterStellar Regulators]] to eliminate him. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hanthor]] of the Sith Empire was forced to send a retrieval team for Lurker and his family, relocating them to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
